selected_result: Theorem 4.2: stochastic-rounding probabilistic forward-error bound for Horner evaluation

bibliographic_source.title: Error Analysis of Sum-Product Algorithms under Stochastic Rounding

paper_locations.anchor: Theorem 4.2 and equation (4.2), with SR, gamma, and general martingale model in sections 2-3

task_clarification: Let P(x)=sum_{i=0}^n a_i*x^i and evaluate it by Horner's algorithm using n rounded additions and n rounded multiplications under the source stochastic-rounding model SR.
Let K=(sum_{i=0}^n |a_i*x^i|)/|P(x)|, defined where P(x) is nonzero. The source defines gamma_m(u)=(1+u)^m-1.
For every lambda in (0,1), with probability at least 1-lambda, the relative forward error |PHat(x)-P(x)|/|P(x)| is at most K*sqrt(u*gamma_{4*n}(u))*sqrt(log(2/lambda)).
scope_constraints: Preserve the full Horner computation and its stochastic-rounding operation semantics; the final high-probability event may not be an input assumption.
Keep the exact coefficient, polynomial condition number, and n-addition/n-multiplication count; an O(sqrt(n)*u) description is not a substitute.
Do not claim a relative-error theorem at P(x)=0 without an independently justified source interpretation.
